note: Zoom on the sideboard against the back wall of the entrance hall. Feminine on the left (la soirée, la veille, la demi-heure), l'après-midi (both genders) in the middle, masculine on the right (le lendemain, le retard, le midi, le minuit). The blank card on the wall is the sign.
